arguments.message: shaft power more than 8 pct above sustainable after the start

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 600 and shaft_power_w < 0.92 * sustainable_shaft_power_w
arguments.message: shaft power more than 8 pct below sustainable: reserve being left unused
speed at same rate down more than 4 pct vs early race
1300 m to go: plan the finish

arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m. Even effort near sustainable shaft power (about 190 W at start, cp_shaft 184), spend the pod reserve by the finish, final sprint from about 400-600 m out. Start was hot (254 W shaft, pod reserve 74 pct at 1 min); expecting natural settle by min 2-3. Watches set: overspend, underspend, fade, finish_plan (1300 m to go). Leg 1 has current against (-0.2 m/s).

text: no cue: start still settling at minute 1; set pacing watches and wrote the race plan.

arguments.text: Settle a touch now. Long smooth strokes, save it for later.

Min 3.8 (712 m): still overspending, shaft 213 W vs sustainable 188, pod reserve 40 pct, boat reserve 21 pct. Cued ease (no pace target, because the turn at 1000 m flips the current from about -0.18 to about +0.18 m/s). Target shaft about 185-190 W. Check effect after the turn; with current helping, ground pace near 150-155 s/500 is the same effort as about 168 into the current.

text: Cued ease: shaft power 213 W against 188 W sustainable, pod reserve already 40 pct with 5.3 km left.

arguments.text: Back off a little. Hold 148 pace on this leg.

Min 6.8 (1297 m): first ease did not stick (shaft 197 then back to 207 W). Pod reserve 18 pct, boat reserve 0 pct but no fade yet (-0.2 pct). Paddler says 10/10, really hurting: believe the pod, CP probably not much higher. Cued ease with ground pace 148 on leg 2 (current helping about +0.24 m/s) = about 182 W shaft, near CP. Plan: hold near CP (about 184 W) and keep the small reserve for the last 500 m. At the turn at 2000 m (into current about -0.2) the same effort is about 168-170 s/500 over the ground: re-cue pace then. If fade appears or paddler blows up, ease more.

arguments.message: past the 2000 m turn, into the current: re-set the pace target (about 168-170 s/500 for CP effort)

text: Cued ease to 148 pace with the current: pod reserve 18 pct, paddler at 10/10 hurting; set a watch for the next turn.

arguments.text: Min 7.1: escort radio says wind filling in from the north, 8-12 knots. North legs (3 and 5, heading about 0 deg) will be into wind and current; south legs (2, 4, 6 incl. the finish) downwind. Ground-pace targets will be off as wind builds (push_along lags): prefer effort cues (shaft power near 184 W), and if anything a little more effort into the wind, a little less downwind. 148 pace cue given at 6.9 min, check shaft dropped toward 185 W.

arguments.message: ease cue not taken: shaft still above 196 W

text: no cue: ease cue just given (cue gate closed 49 s); noted the north wind and set a watch to check the ease takes.

arguments.text: This effort is right now. Hold it, breathe, long strokes.

Min 8.6 (1693 m): paddler says cooked, cannot hold this. Shaft eased to 179-184 W (at CP 184); pod reserve 14 pct and now recovering slowly. Boat-speed numbers are inflated by the building tailwind (push_local 0.42 vs push_along 0.25), so ignore boat reserve; trust the pod. Cued hold at this effort (no pace target). Next: at the 2000 m turn (into wind and current) keep shaft near 180-185 W, accept slow ground pace; do not let the paddler sag below about 175 W.

text: Cued hold: paddler says cooked but shaft power is now at critical power (about 180 W) with 14 pct pod reserve, a sustainable effort.

arguments.text: Into the wind now: lift back to your strong, steady rhythm.

Min 10.1 (2008 m, leg 3 north, into wind and current): shaft sagged to 165 W after the hold cue, pod reserve recovered to 22 pct. Cued push (no pace target) to get back to about 180-185 W. Effort into the wind is worth more time than downwind. Watch for overshoot above about 195 W.

text: Cued push into the wind: shaft power sagged to 165 W, below the 186 W sustainable, while pod reserve recovered to 22 pct.

arguments.text: Slow pace is the headwind. Your effort is perfect, keep it.

arguments.name: drag_resid
arguments.description: local push minus fitted push: alternates sign with lagging wind estimate; negative on both directions suggests extra drag such as weed on the rudder

arguments.condition: (heading_deg > 90 and heading_deg < 270 and drag_resid < -0.1) or drag_resid < -0.33
arguments.message: possible extra drag (weed on rudder?): local push well below fitted push

arguments.text: Min 11.9 (2293 m, leg 3 upwind): fade alert -7.9 pct is mostly wind plus lower power (shaft 185 vs 210 early at the same rate), not the blade. push_local minus push_along was +0.15 downwind (leg 2) and -0.15 upwind now: a lagging wind signature, not weed. Removed fade watch; added drag_resid metric and extra_drag watch (negative residual on a downwind leg = suspect rudder weed, consider clear_rudder). Shaft 182-185 W, pod reserve 22 pct, sustainable 186: effort right. Cued reassure (display pace 184 s/500 into wind).

text: Cued reassure: fade alert is the headwind and lower power, shaft 185 W matches sustainable; replaced the fade watch with an extra-drag watch.

arguments.text: Good. Ease a fraction, smooth and steady to the turn.

Min 13.1 (2501 m): push cue overshot, shaft 198 W vs sustainable 186, pod reserve back down to 17 pct (empties in about 590 m at 198). Cued a small ease. Upwind effort is worth only about 20 pct more per joule than downwind, so aim about 188-190 W upwind and about 182 W downwind, never empty the pod reserve before the last 600 m.

text: Cued small ease: shaft 198 W against 186 W sustainable would empty the pod reserve within about 600 m.

arguments.text: Downwind now. Ease a touch, let it run, recover.

arguments.message: pod reserve nearly empty with more than 800 m to go

arguments.text: Min 16.1 (2995 m, turn to leg 4 downwind): paddler held 191-197 W shaft through leg 3 despite the small ease; pod reserve down to 7 pct, sustainable now about CP (185). The paddler drifts back to about 193 W after every ease. Cued ease for the downwind leg to rebuild a little reserve (aim about 178-182 W). Added near_empty watch (pod reserve < 4 pct, > 800 m left). Finish: sprint from about 400-500 m out with whatever reserve is left; last leg 6 is downwind.

text: Cued ease for the downwind leg: pod reserve 7 pct with 3 km left and shaft 197 W above the 185 W sustainable.
no cue: ease cue spoken 10 s ago and still taking effect; push readings still include the turn.

arguments.name: drag_index
arguments.description: speed through the water per cube root of shaft power: drops when hull drag rises (weed); about 0.556-0.559 on downwind legs so far, about 0.535 upwind (air drag)

arguments.message: downwind leg: boat slower than shaft power predicts, suspect weed on rudder

arguments.text: Min 16.9 (3160 m, leg 4 downwind): pod reserve 3 pct, shaft still 194 W; paddler 9/10, says boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Checked: downwind speed through water 3.22 m/s at 194 W matches leg 2 (3.30 at 205 W) and push_local is above push_along, so no extra drag in the data now; likely fatigue. Added drag_index (speed_water over cube root of shaft power; downwind about 0.556) and drag_downwind watch (< 0.535 on a south leg). If it fires, cue clear_rudder. Cueing ease with pace 146 downwind (about 180 W). Upwind leg 5 equivalent about 185 s/500.
Boat is running clean. Ease to 146 pace, recover now.

arguments.name: drag_index
arguments.description: cube of speed through the water per W of shaft power: drops when hull drag rises (weed); about 0.172-0.174 downwind so far, about 0.154 upwind (air drag)

arguments.message: downwind leg: boat slower than shaft power predicts, suspect weed on rudder

arguments.text: Boat is running clean. Ease to 146 pace, recover now.

text: Cued ease to 146 pace downwind and told the paddler the boat is clean: pod reserve 3 pct, data show no extra drag; set a downwind drag watch.

arguments.message: past the 4000 m turn, upwind leg 5: cue push with pace about 183 s/500 (about 186 W)
about 430 m to go: cue the finish sprint now (no cues allowed in the last 100 m)

arguments.text: Min 19.9 (3789 m, leg 4 downwind): ease took, shaft 176 W, pod reserve back up to 7 pct (about 1.2 kJ). drag_index 0.174 = normal, no weed. Plan: leg 5 upwind (4000-5000 m) at about 186-188 W, ground pace about 183 s/500 (leg 3 upwind gave 180-182 s/500 at 192 W, wind about the same), cue push with that pace at the turn (watch turn_4000). Leg 6 downwind to the finish: hold, then finish cue at about 430 m to go (watch finish_go). Cues spoken so far 8; keep spare for the finish.

text: no cue: shaft 176 W downwind is rebuilding the pod reserve (7 pct); set watches to cue the upwind push at the 4000 m turn and the finish sprint at about 430 m.

arguments.text: Min 20.1 (3824 m): paddler says this hurts, does not think they can keep it up, but shaft is 176 W (below CP) and pod reserve rising (8 pct). No cue now to save the cue budget (8 spoken); at the 4000 m turn give one encouraging push cue with pace 183 into the wind, then the finish cue at about 430 m.

text: no cue: paddler is below critical power and recovering; saving the cue for the upwind push at the turn 50 s ahead.

arguments.text: Into the wind: dig in, hold 182 pace. You have this.

Min 21.1 (4029 m, leg 5 upwind): pod reserve recovered to 13 pct (2.1 kJ), sustainable 187 W. Cued push with ground pace 182 (about 188-190 W, judged from leg 3 upwind). Target: spend about 1.5 kJ on this upwind leg, keep about 0.6 kJ plus recovery for the downwind finish sprint. If shaft goes above about 197 W, ease slightly.

text: Cued push to 182 pace into the wind: pod reserve recovered to 13 pct, so the upwind leg is where extra effort buys the most time.

arguments.text: Ease a fraction. Hold 188 pace to the turn.

Min 23.6 (4430 m, leg 5 upwind, 570 m to turn): push overshot again, shaft 197 W, pod reserve 5 pct (empties in about 180 m). Cued ease to 188 pace (about 186 W) to reach the turn with some reserve. Cues spoken: 10. Remaining plan: finish cue at about 430 m to go (watch finish_go); a downwind settle cue at the 5000 m turn only if the cap allows (unknown cap).

text: Cued ease to 188 pace: shaft 197 W would empty the 5 pct pod reserve within about 180 m with 1.5 km left.
no cue: ease cue spoken 12 s ago is still taking effect and the cue gate is closed for 48 s.

arguments.text: Min 26.4 (4876 m, 124 m before the last turn): pod reserve reads 0 but shaft still 192 W with no extra fade (upwind fade -6.5 to -7.9 pct, same as leg 3). The paddler has held about 190-195 W for long stretches at a near-empty model reserve: true shaft CP is probably higher than 184 (maybe 190-195), so the paddler likely has a little more than the model says. Pace cues seem to set an effort at cue time that carries through turns, so no turn cue: the 188-pace effort (about 190 W) is fine downwind. Next and probably last cue: finish at about 430 m to go (watch finish_go). Cues spoken 10.

text: no cue: paddler holding about 190 W with no fade despite an empty model reserve; saving the cue budget for the finish sprint at about 430 m.

arguments.text: Min 29.3 (5451 m, 549 m to go, downwind): paddler started their own finish sprint, shaft 240 W, rate 68. Model pod reserve 0 but evidence says true CP about 190-192, which would leave roughly 6-9 kJ: enough for a sprint of about 150 s. No ease cue. At the finish_go wake (430 m): if shaft is still above about 225 W, no cue; if they have dropped back below about 200 W, cue finish.

text: no cue: the paddler has started their own sprint at 240 W with 550 m left, and the race evidence suggests they have the reserve for it.
no cue: paddler is sprinting at 247 W with 450 m left and speed still rising; removed the pacing watches so the finish is not interrupted.
no cue: drag alert at 262 m to go is ambiguous (sprint at high rate) and a rudder-clearing back-stroke would cost more than it could save this close to the line.
